items.prompt: One single continuous shot from a fixed camera at the entrance of a gravel forest track in early spring in Hokkaido: a Japanese hunter in a blaze-orange vest and orange cap, seen only from behind, walks into the frame, lifts one of the packed backpacks from the folding table onto his shoulder, picks up the coil of rope and walks slowly away down the road, leaving the track entrance empty and quiet. His face is never visible. No cuts, no scene change. No snow anywhere. 8 seconds. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style.
